Settings

Display
Spectral OFL · statements, light with one heavy phrase
Text
IBM Plex Sans OFL
Mono
Azeret Mono OFL · amounts and ids in tables
Moves
type-only hero, no giant size, hierarchy by weight, serif display, tabular figures
Mood
calm, exact, trustworthy, grown-up
Case
Sentence case throughout; no capitals except currency codes.
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; font-feature-settings: "zero" 1

1 240.00 · 18 460.50 · 307.101 240.00 · 18 460.50 · 307.10

Amounts right-aligned with tabular figures; the serif statement uses proportional old-style figures inside sentences.
Signature
The headline is a 44 px light serif sentence with one phrase in semibold; the largest thing on screen is a statement, not a figure. Weight replaces size and colour.
Use when
Invoicing, accounting, banking, payroll, any money screen where calm accuracy beats excitement.
Turns into slop when
When the figure is pulled out and set at 96 px (the hero-number tell), when green and red colour every amount, or when the light serif is used under 20 px.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
